uv run --locked python -c 'import subprocess as sp, json, re, sys, os, glob, tempfile, datetime as dt, zoneinfo; F = lambda c, m: c or sys.exit("W6.6 FAIL: " + m); g = lambda *a: sp.run(["git", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=sp.DEVNULL); T = "prereg-v1"; DOC = "docs/prereg/ordering_sentence.md"; MAD = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Europe/Madrid"); NARROW = "the sealed-set definition and acceptance criteria were committed publicly before the sealed set was opened"; d = open(DOC, encoding="utf-8").read(); R = json.load(open("quality/receipts/W3.13.json")); F(R.get("step") == "W3.13" and R.get("status") == "PASS" and R.get("exit") == 0, "W3.13 is not done: its receipt is not PASS with exit 0"); tobj = g("rev-parse", "refs/tags/" + T).stdout.strip(); F(tobj and g("cat-file", "-t", tobj).stdout.strip() == "tag", "prereg-v1 is not an annotated tag"); tc = g("rev-parse", T + "^{commit}").stdout.strip(); tt = int(g("log", "-1", "--format=%ct", tc).stdout.strip()); rl = g("ls-remote", "--tags", "origin", "refs/tags/" + T); F(rl.returncode == 0 and rl.stdout.split()[:1] == [tobj], "origin does not carry the local prereg-v1 tag object: %r %r" % (rl.stdout.strip(), rl.stderr.strip())); F(("`" + tobj[:7] + "`") in d and ("`" + tc[:7] + "`") in d, "the file does not name the tag object %s and the tagged commit %s" % (tobj[:7], tc[:7])); tdate = g("tag", "-l", "--format=%(taggerdate:iso-strict)", T).stdout.strip(); F(("`" + tdate + "`") in d, "the file does not carry the tagger date " + tdate); s = sp.run(["bash", "tools/comms/check_seal_order.sh"], capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=sp.DEVNULL); print(s.stdout.strip()); F(s.returncode == 0, "GD-12 exited %d: %s" % (s.returncode, s.stderr.strip())); prov = sorted(glob.glob("out/**/provenance.json", recursive=True)); n_prov_pre = len([p for p in prov if os.path.getmtime(p) < tt]); pm = g("show", T + ":PREREGISTRATION.md").stdout; said = "The fits listed above ran before it" in pm; F(("
> " + NARROW + "
") in pm, "the tagged PREREGISTRATION.md does not quote the D-67 narrow sentence verbatim"); c0 = (g("log", "--diff-filter=A", "--format=%H", "--", "quality/receipts/W3.4.json").stdout.split() or [""])[-1]; F(c0 and g("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", c0, tc).returncode == 0, "the commit that added the first W3.4 receipt is not an ancestor of the tag"); w = json.loads(g("show", c0 + ":quality/receipts/W3.4.json").stdout); w_pre = g("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", tc, w["git_sha"]).returncode != 0; w_t = dt.datetime.strptime(w["timestamp_madrid"][:19], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").replace(tzinfo=MAD).timestamp(); F(("`" + w["timestamp_madrid"] + "`") in d and ("`" + c0[:7] + "`") in d and ("`" + w["git_sha"][:7] + "`") in d, "the file does not carry the first W3.4 receipt: %s, commit %s, git_sha %s" % (w["timestamp_madrid"], c0[:7], w["git_sha"][:7])); recs = sorted(glob.glob("out/dev/ch1_spec/fits/*.json") + glob.glob("out/dev/ch1_spec/noncohort/fits/*.json")); J = [(p, json.load(open(p)), os.path.getmtime(p)) for p in recs]; pre = [x for x in J if x[2] < tt]; real = [x for x in pre if x[1].get("seasons_in_fit") == ["2022", "2023", "2024"]]; F(pre and real and all("git_sha" not in x[1] for x in pre), "no pre-tag fit record in out/dev/ch1_spec, or one carries a git_sha, against what the file says"); mx = max(x[1]["n_fit"] for x in real); fm = lambda t: dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(t, MAD).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"); lo, hi = fm(min(x[2] for x in pre)), fm(max(x[2] for x in pre)); F(("`" + lo + "`") in d and ("`" + hi + "`") in d, "the pre-tag fit record window in the file is not %s to %s" % (lo, hi)); first_fit = min([w_t] + [x[2] for x in pre]); F(tt - first_fit > 4 * 86400, "the first Chapter 1 fit is not more than four days before the tagged commit"); achieved = (not said) and (not w_pre) and (not pre); want = "wide" if achieved else "narrow"; choice = re.findall(r"(?m)^Chosen sentence: (narrow|wide)\.$", d); F(len(choice) == 1, "the file must record exactly one chosen sentence, found %s" % choice); F(choice[0] == want, "the file chose the %s sentence, but the achieved ordering supports the %s one" % (choice[0], want)); F(choice[0] != "narrow" or ("
> " + NARROW + "
") in d, "the file does not quote the D-67 narrow sentence verbatim"); cap = NARROW[0].upper() + NARROW[1:] + "."; AB = ["abstract/ssac2027_abstract.md"] + sorted(glob.glob("abstract/variants/ssac2027_abstract.*.md")); miss = [p for p in AB if cap not in open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()]; F(choice[0] != "narrow" or not miss, "an abstract source does not carry the narrow sentence: %s" % miss); fs = open("tools/comms/fill_slots.R", encoding="utf-8").read(); m = re.search(r"WIDE <- paste\("([^"]*)",\s*"([^"]*)"\)", fs); F(m, "the WIDE string in tools/comms/fill_slots.R was not found"); WIDE = m.group(1) + " " + m.group(2); rd = lambda p: open(p, "rb").read().decode("utf-8", "ignore"); tree = [p for r0 in ("abstract", "submissions") for p in glob.glob(r0 + "/**", recursive=True) if os.path.isfile(p)]; hits = [p for p in tree if WIDE in rd(p) or "publicly before estimation" in rd(p)]; F(choice[0] != "narrow" or not hits, "the wide sentence appears in %s" % hits); F("`WIDE`" in d and "`tools/comms/fill_slots.R`" in d, "the file does not name the refused WIDE string in tools/comms/fill_slots.R"); num = lambda pat: [int(x.replace(",", "")) for x in re.findall(pat, d)]; L = {"w313_receipt_exit": R["exit"], "gd12_exit": s.returncode, "provenance_before_tag": n_prov_pre, "fit_records_before_tag": len(pre), "fit_records_2022_2024": len(real), "fit_records_simulated": len(pre) - len(real), "max_rows_2022_2024": mx}; ctx = [(r"receipt reads PASS with exit (\d+)", "w313_receipt_exit"), (r"`bash tools/comms/check_seal_order.sh`, exits (\d+)", "gd12_exit"), (r"Before the tag there were (\d+) of them", "provenance_before_tag"), (r"left (\d+) fit records", "fit_records_before_tag"), (r"(\d+) of them fit 2022.2024 called pitches", "fit_records_2022_2024"), (r"The other (\d+) fit simulated data", "fit_records_simulated"), (r"at most ([\d,]+) rows each", "max_rows_2022_2024")]; bad = [(k, num(p), L[k]) for p, k in ctx if num(p) != [L[k]]]; F(not bad, "a count in the file differs from its recomputed source (name, file, source): %s" % bad); tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", delete=False); json.dump(L, tf); tf.close(); c = sp.run([sys.executable, "quality/check_numbers.py", "--ledger", tf.name, DOC], capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=sp.DEVNULL); os.unlink(tf.name); print(c.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if c.stdout.strip() else c.stderr.strip()); F(c.returncode == 0, "quality/check_numbers.py does not trace every number in the file: " + c.stdout.strip()[-600:]); lp = sp.run([sys.executable, "quality/prose_lint.py", DOC], capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=sp.DEVNULL); print(lp.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if lp.stdout.strip() else lp.stderr.strip()); F(lp.returncode == 0, "quality/prose_lint.py fails the file: " + lp.stdout.strip()[-600:]); print("W6.6 OK: W3.13 PASS; %s object %s on %s, same object on origin; GD-12 exit %d; ordering not achieved (tagged PREREGISTRATION.md says fits ran before it: %s; first W3.4 receipt %s at %s, not a descendant: %s; %d pre-tag fit records, %d on 2022-2024, max %d rows); chosen %s; %d abstract sources carry it; 0 wide hits in %d files; %d counts traced" % (T, tobj[:7], tc[:7], s.returncode, said, w["timestamp_madrid"], w["git_sha"][:7], w_pre, len(pre), len(real), mx, choice[0], len(AB), len(tree), len(ctx)))'
title: PRE-REGISTRATION == M1 == W3.13, sprint view: the abstract's D-67 sentence matches the ordering achieved
